The future of work has arrived.
A lot of firms have been allowing their employees to work from home three days a week, a change initiated during the pandemic but which, due to employee satisfaction, proved to be lasting.
Managers initially feared that it would affect efficiency but in reality, its not performance that's affected, but culture.
Now machine learning algorithms are being used to more efficiently manage supply chains, anticipate consumer needs and perform functions that were once considered to require human intelligence.

For most companies, it is now impossible to function without it, but when it comes to adoption and implementation many are stumped by the lack of tech skills or a well-defined way of leveraging the technology.
Advances in this exciting area of tech are driving multiple sectors to achieve new levels of innovation.
Given all that, adoptions increased 42% in 2025.
Financial services have embraced automation with particular enthusiasm.
Algorithmic trading now accounts for a majority of market volume.
